description: Grants the remotely-hosted Orcaa PWA access to a minimal set of native commands. The wrapper never loads a local page — the webview always sits on an https://*.orcaa.cloud origin — and Tauri denies EVERY IPC call coming from a remote origin unless that origin is listed in a capability's `remote.urls`. Without this file `plugin:notification|notify` is rejected and OS toasts silently never fire. Kept separate from `default.json` (which stays local-only). Beyond notifications it grants: the custom-titlebar window commands + drag region (`allow-shell-window`, `core:window:allow-start-dragging`/`allow-internal-toggle-maximize` — the web topbar IS the titlebar on Windows), the unread badge (`allow-shell-badge`), and `opener:allow-open-url` (URL scheme-scoped below — deliberately NOT `open_path` or `reveal_item_in_dir`, so the hosted page can never open a local file/executable). The opener plugin injects a shim that routes `window.open`/`target="_blank"` through `plugin:opener|open_url`; without this grant every external link (About Orcaa, Get apps, WhatsApp, meeting links…) died with `Command plugin:opener|open_url not allowed by ACL` and never reached the browser.
